headline: Teladoc Health has added two AI tools to its hospital platform, one that tracks heart and breathing rates without touch and one that writes visit notes.
score_reason: Kept at 5: a product launch with no accuracy results; the vitals tool is in limited preview.
importance_line: What is new: AI that reads vital signs through a camera and writes visit notes is reaching hospitals, which matters first to patients and the clinicians who would rely on these readings, and the honest doubt is that the vitals tool is only in private preview and the article gives no accuracy results.
summary: Healthcare Dive reports that Teladoc Health, a telehealth company, has added SoloScribe, an AI tool that records and writes up clinical visits and is now available, and SoloVitals, which tracks heart and breathing rates from a camera and is in private preview with wider release expected in December. Teladoc says one platform is a real benefit for hospitals juggling many tools, while Healthcare Dive notes the integration would also benefit Teladoc, which posted a $200.3 million net loss in 2025 and lowered its 2026 revenue outlook in July.
notes: Fierce Healthcare pool link blocked (403); the Healthcare Dive piece covers the same 7 Oct announcement. Company statements are attributed to Teladoc.
